newsitem.title: UK: Bradford wool market sees steady demand.
newsitem.headline: Bradford wool market sees steady demand.

text.p: Brokers reported fairly steady demand and a good level of enquiry in the Bradford woollen tops market on Monday.
Prices for finer tops tended lower and most other prices were unchanged, influenced by continuing overcapacity and limited demand from China, brokers said.
But many trade sources believe that a recovery on the back of a currently "bottomed-out" primary wool market is on the way.
"Demand fundamentals are looking a little healthier," one source said.
